text_block_list.text:
Bravo! Your appearance today is simply 
marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Brava! Your appearance today is simply 
marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Polished teeth are clair. With not a trace 
of the past, their serene alignment is an 
orchestra!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Your nails are staccato, yet legato! 
Liscio right down to your shoes! Such 
flawlessness is simply bravissimo!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Listen, I can hear it...! Coming from you: 
rat-a-tat, rat-a-tat, rat-tat-tat... An 
orderly, yet valiant marcha!
